scripts.check: bun --filter r2ex-dashboard check && bun --filter r2ex check
scripts.lint: bun x @biomejs/biome check packages/dashboard/src packages/worker/src || (bun x @biomejs/biome check --write packages/dashboard/src packages/worker/src/; exit 1)
scripts.test: bun --filter r2ex test && bun --filter r2ex-dashboard test
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build-dashboard && bun x playwright test --config packages/dashboard/playwright.config.ts
scripts.build: bun run build-dashboard && bun run build-worker
scripts.release: bun run build && bun --filter r2ex publint && changeset publish
